text_block_list.text:
The battle at the Takarazuka Kinen ends
with
Biwa Hayahide taking first place.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, Ticket tells Hayahide
how she
hopes they can stay rivals
forever and always run
the best of races
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But Бива Хаяхидэ replies that unlike
when they
clashed at the Japanese
Derby, she finds it
difficult to consider
Уиннинг Тикит her rival
anymore.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hayahide tells her to think long and
hard about
the reason why she races,
leaving Ticket
dumbfounded.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
